items.source:
Each message has a kind (info, warn, error) and a code number. Tests can be written to
expect particular code numbers rather than particular text, enabling the message text
to more easily be modified and the tests to run successfully in different locales.
items.translation: 每个消息都有一个类型（info、warn、error）和一个代码编号。可以编写测试以期望特定的代码编号，而不是特定的文本，从而更易于修改消息文本，并使测试在不同区域设置下成功运行。

Produce a complete message including the prefix and with the inserts
applied to the message.
items.translation: 生成包含前缀并应用插入内容的完整消息。

items.source: inserts - the inserts to put into the formatted message
items.translation: inserts - 要放入格式化消息中的插入项

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
